title: Action-Set-Informed Design and System Implementation of a Compact Language Model for Smart-Lighting Control — data and code
description: Data, code, evaluation outputs, frozen policy catalogue, catalogue-gate implementation and selected compact language model accompanying the Electronics article. Version 1.1.0 adds the first-round revision in revision_round1/: the audited request set and its evaluations, the random-subset series over three draws, the per-action exposure, depth Pareto, search-counterfactual and quantization-boundary analyses, the retrained deployed architecture, the 240-class heads and the end-to-end software-path measurement.

creators.name: Hong, Yong-Geun
creators.affiliation: School of AI Software, Daejeon University
